pass_rule: PASS requires zero open CRITICAL or HIGH findings.

chain.subject: Optimize generation with profiled batching and resumable chunks
Integrate profiled generation and reuse selected dev artifacts
Fix variable-length generation padding and reuse validation

findings.summary: Variable-length decoder-only inference batches were right-padded.
findings.closure: _inference_batch now compacts active tokens and left-pads; _generate_batch slices after the common padded input length. A causal fixture whose continuation depends on each row's last active token passes batch 1/2/4 equivalence.

findings.summary: Batch >1 evidence was previously permissive when omitted.
findings.closure: Batch >1 now requires an explicit True profiled, measured, or approved field; a missing profile still resolves to safe batch one.

findings.summary: DEV reuse lacked complete selected-artifact binding.
findings.closure: Reuse now checks best_epoch, selected/best checkpoint hash, reasoning/prediction/judge hashes, metrics hash, and chunk-manifest hash; the marker test covers validation and tamper rejection.

findings.summary: The selected epoch checkpoint file and source_root are not independently cross-checked during reuse.
findings.rationale: The best checkpoint hash, best_epoch, and all published DEV artifact hashes are bound and fail closed under normal publication. This is additional provenance hardening, not an acceptance blocker.
findings.exact_fix: Publish and verify the hash of checkpoints/epoch_<best_epoch>/model.pt and require source_root == epochs/epoch_<best_epoch>.

findings.summary: Fixture-only stage adapters retain direct torch.save calls.
findings.rationale: Production/trainable generation uses the canonical checkpoint helper; no duplicate production serializer was introduced.
